question: The average of the squares of the first 47 natural numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the squares of the first n natural numbers can be calculated directly using the formula: (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6

Here, the total number of terms, n = 47.

Average = (47 + 1)(2 × 47 + 1) ÷ 6

Average = (48 × 95) ÷ 6 = 8 × 95 = 760

**∴ The correct answer is 760.**
